column1: # Pinned guest images for the CUSE acceptance tier.
# Columns, tab-separated: target, architecture, image file name, SHA-256,
# download URL. scripts/cuse-image.sh refuses bytes that do not match.
#              published beside the image on dl.rockylinux.org together with a
#              detached signature (.CHECKSUM.asc) from the Rocky Linux 10
#              file published beside the image on dl.fedoraproject.org.
# To move a pin, take the new file name and SHA-256 from the distribution's
# signed checksum file, never from a downloaded image.
